page_title: LEN 0-0 NIC | Lens v Nice 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Dante (Nice).
90+5' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Hicham Boudaoui is replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
90+4' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

90+1' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) rose high to meet a perfectly taken corner kick and attempted to steer a fine header from inside the box towards the right side of the goal. Nobody knows what would have happened if one of the defending players hadn’t pulled off a brilliant intervention to block the effort. Now Lens have a corner.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90' Here is a change. Badredine Bouanani is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Sofiane Diop (Nice).
89' Today's match ends for Andy Diouf who will be replaced by Nampalys Mendy (Lens).
88' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
85' Referee Francois Letexier halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Will Still, then shows him a yellow.
84' Francois Letexier blows his whistle and Anass Zaroury (Lens) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
83' Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
78' Here comes a substitution. Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is brought on as a substitute for Przemyslaw Frankowski.
78' Will Still has decided to make a change. Martin Satriano (Lens) replaces M'Bala Nzola.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jeremie Boga walks off the pitch to be replaced by Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice).
77' The ball is out of play. Lens will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Marcin Bulka.
67' Anass Zaroury (Lens) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.

66' What a save from Brice Samba! Pablo Rosario (Nice) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
65' The Nice players can’t believe it after referee Francois Letexier signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
63' Celebrations by Nice are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
63' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
62' Jeremie Boga (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
59' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) replacing Wesley Said.
59' Here comes a substitution. Angelo Fulgini is given a rest as he is replaced by Anass Zaroury (Lens).
57' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
57' Ali Abdi (Nice) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
56' 4:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
53' Jeremie Boga (Nice) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
53' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
52' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards the middle of the goal and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
52' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lens.
52' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
50' The ball is cleared after Wesley Said (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' Great teamplay by Lens as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Mohamed Abdelmonem is replaced by Dante (Nice).
46' Franck Haise has made a change at the break. Jonathan Clauss (Nice) has come on in place of Antoine Mendy.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
42' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:0.
38' Nice take a short corner kick.
36' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
34' A spell of possession for Lens in an attempt to control the game.
31' The ratio of the ball possession is 68:32.
31' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' What was Mohamed Abdelmonem (Nice) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
28' Great touch by Badredine Bouanani (Nice) as he received a precise pass on the edge of the box. His powerful shot bounced off the goalkeeper’s gloves and hit the post.
27' A quickly taken corner by Lens.
26' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Marcin Bulka, who makes a comfortable save.
25' Deiver Machado (Lens) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

22' Deiver Machado (Lens) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
21' Lens are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.
16' Pablo Rosario (Nice) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
12' Lens work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

12' Wesley Said (Lens) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the right side of the goal, but Marcin Bulka makes a magnificent save! Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
12' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
8' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
7' Lens take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Neat passing move from Lens in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
Lens will kick-off.
Francois Letexier will supervise the game today.
